zh.doc: 密钥封装算法 · NGCC ASIC 排行榜
title: 密钥封装算法
zh.tagline: 新一代商用密码算法征集活动（NGCC）密钥封装候选算法的 ASIC 实现，在统一工艺与约束下比较运算吞吐量和面积。
method: 一次密钥生成、一次封装和一次解封装计为一次运算，对应一次使用临时密钥对的密钥建立。运算吞吐量 = 工作频率 ÷ 三者的平均时钟周期数之和。时钟周期数取多次运行的平均值。
面积为综合后逻辑面积与 SRAM 面积之和，按 NAND2 等效门数计（kGE）。吞面比 = 运算吞吐量 ÷ 面积。
按 NGCC 规定的经典安全强度等级分组，在等级内按运算吞吐量排名。同一算法在同一等级有多个参数集时，取运算吞吐量最高的一个。
指标定义参照商用密码标准研究院《新一代商用密码算法 ASIC 实现自评估指引》（2026 年 6 月）。各实现采用相同的综合约束模板，在各自的工作频率下通过静态时序分析。与指引的差异：工作频率取综合目标频率（最差建立时间裕量接近 0），未做频率扫描；SRAM 面积由 {sram} 估算。

title: KEY
ENCAPSULATION
en.tagline: ASIC implementations of the key encapsulation candidates in the Next-generation Commercial Cryptographic Algorithms Program (NGCC), compared on throughput and area under a common process and constraint set.
method: One key generation, one encapsulation and one decapsulation count as one operation, which corresponds to one key establishment with an ephemeral key pair. Throughput = clock frequency ÷ the sum of their mean clock cycles. Clock cycles are averaged over repeated runs.
Area is post-synthesis logic area plus SRAM area, in NAND2 gate equivalents (kGE). Throughput / area = throughput ÷ area.

Implementations are grouped by the NGCC classical security strength levels and ranked by throughput within each level. When an algorithm has several parameter sets at one level, the one with the highest throughput is used.

Metric definitions follow the ICCS ASIC self-evaluation guide for next-generation commercial cryptographic algorithms (新一代商用密码算法 ASIC 实现自评估指引, June 2026). All implementations use the same synthesis constraint template and pass static timing analysis at their own clock frequency. Differences from the guide: the clock frequency is the synthesis target (worst setup slack close to 0), with no frequency sweep; SRAM area is a {sram} estimate.
